čiṅgis: Čiṅgis — Chinggis, the title borne by Temüjin from 1206 [Ming gloss: 太祖名, 'the name of Taizu']
ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
žarčiγ̇udai: Žarčiγ̇udai — Jarchiudai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
ürču: ür- — to carry on the back (stem inferred from the Ming); converb -ču, 'carrying on the back' (verb, converb after r) [負着]
želme: Želme — Jelme, a son's name (personal name) [兒名]
burqan-qaldun-ača: Burqan-Qaldun — Burqan Qaldun, a mountain; ablative -ača, 'from Burqan Qaldun' (name + case, back-vowel form) [山名 自]
baγ̇užu: baγu- — to come down, descend; converb -žu, 'descending' (verb, converb) [下來着] · baγ̇u- also 'to dismount, to camp' (Ming 下), converb -žu 'dismounting, camping' [下着]
irerün: ire- — to come; converb -rün, 'coming, while coming' (verb, converb) [來的]
onan: Onan — the Onon, the river of Chinggis's homeland [河名, 'name of a river']
nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的] · also printed after stems that already end in n (Menen-Tudun-(n)u, Qačin-(n)u, Qaγan-(n)u, Onan-(n)u), where the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 的 as elsewhere · also küġün-(n)u, 'of a person' · also printed after Waṅ-Qān-(n)u, 'of Wang Qan' (Ming 的), where the (n) is Shiratori's
deliġün-boldaγ-a: Deliġün-Boldaγ — Deligün-Boldaq, a place; dative-locative -a, 'at Deligün-Boldaq' (place name + case; Ming 地名(行)) [地名(行)]
nama-ji: nama-ji — me, as object (bi, stem nama-, + accusative -ji after a vowel) [我行]
töreküi-dür: töre- — to be born; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the birth, when born' (verb, participle + case; Ming 生時) [生時]
ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
büleġei: bü- — to be; -leġei past: 'there was, used to be' (a variant of -leġe; Ming 來) [有來]
tere: tere — that, that one; also 'he, she' (demonstrative and third-person pronoun; plural tede) [那般] · also with Ming 那 ('that'), before a noun: tere deleme üge
bosoγa-jin: bosoγa — threshold (noun; Ming 門限) + genitive -jin, 'of the threshold' (noun + case, after a vowel) [門限的]
emčü: emčü — one's own, private (adjective; Ming 梯已, 'personal'), so 'private slave' [梯已]
bolba-že: bol- — to become, be; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed', 'agreed to be, became' (verb, past + particle; Ming 肻做了 'agreed to be') [肻做了 也者︀]
želme-jin: Želme — Jelme, a man's name (personal name); -jin: genitive: of (after a vowel) [人名 的]
tusa: tusa — use, help, benefit (noun; Ming 濟) [濟] · also Ming 恩 'favour, kindness'
in-ü: in-ü — his, her, its (third-person genitive, placed after its noun) [他的]
olon: olon — many (adjective or quantifier; Ming 多) [多]
bi-že: bü- — to be; stem bi- before -že, 'indeed is' (verb + assertion particle -že, 'indeed, surely') [有]
töreldügsen: töre- — to be born; reciprocal-collective -ldü-, 'together'; past participle -gsen, 'born together' (verb, participle) [共生了的]
ösülčegsen: ös- — to grow; reciprocal-collective -ülče-, 'together'; past participle -gsen, 'grown together' (verb, participle) [共長了的]
ölžetü: ölže — good fortune, felicity; -tü 'having', 'fortunate' (noun + possessive-adjective suffix) [吉慶]
qutuγtu: qutuγ — blessing, sacred luck; -tu 'having', 'blessed' (noun + possessive-adjective suffix) [吉慶 有的]
jesün: jesün — nine (numeral; Ming 九) [九] · also nine, 'nine times' (Ming 九次)
aldal: aldal — fault, penalty, fine (noun; here the first half of a word broken at the line end, aldal-dür) [罰]
orotuγai: oro- — to enter; optative -tuγai, 'let (him) enter' (Ming 者) (verb, optative/jussive) [入者︀]
keġen: keġe- — to say; keġen 'saying', the converb that closes a quotation (verb, converb) [麽道]
žarliγ: žarliγ — command, decree (Ming 聖旨) (noun) [聖旨]
bolba: bol- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了] · also an auxiliary after a participle in -qu, -kü: bariqu bolba, kürgekü bolba, 'came to seize, came to lay on'
köġün: köġün — son [子] · also read as a collective, 'sons', before a list of several names (Menen-Tudun-(n)u köġün … doloγ̇an, 'seven'; the plural köġüd is the usual form) · also 'lad, young man' (Ming 後生 'junior'), as in köġün küġün 'a young man'
öġere: öġere — other, otherwise, different (adjective or adverb; Ming 別) [別] · also 'apart, separately' (Ming 𠮠)
ker: ker — how, what manner (interrogative adverb; Ming 怎生); in ker ele, 'how, of what sort' [怎生]
medekü: mede- — to know, to manage (Ming 管); participle -kü, 'one who will manage' (verb, participle, front-vowel form) [管]
büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
či: či — you, thou (second-person singular pronoun) [你] · also (uncertain) a particle after a noun, 'as for, if' (Ming 呵), as in ger či oira bijü, not the pronoun 'you'
ulus: ulus — realm, nation, people (noun) [國] · also (Ming 百姓 'the common people') 'people, subjects'
ečige-dēče: ečige — father; ablative -dēče, 'from (the) father' (noun + case, written with long ē) [父行]
bolun: bol- — to become, to be; converb -un, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming 做了) [做了] · also 'when, at the time' (Ming 時) · also in neġükü bolun, 'when setting off, on starting' (the participle neġükü + bolun; Ming 做呵 'when doing'; uncertain) · also bol- 'to become' with converb -un in the sense 'together, as one' (Ming 共) · also bol- with the Ming 上頭 'on account of, therefore' [上頭] · also the Ming 欲做 'wishing to do, about to' (uncertain) [欲做] · also bol- 'to cease, stop' + converb -un (Ming 住) · also dobtulqu bolun 'about to charge, bent on charging' (Ming 要 'wish to'; compare bailduqu bolun) · also with Ming 做 'becoming' (plain converb, ködölkün bolun)
tula: tula — because of, on account of (postposition; the Ming 上頭 'on top of', hence 'for that reason') [上頭]
čerbi: čerbi — cherbi, an office or rank (meaning of the title not known) (noun) [官名]
nere: nere — name (noun) [名] · also 'name, title, rank' (Ming 名分, 'rank'), as in Žaγ̇ud-quri nere, Waṅ nere, 'the title Ja'ud-quri, the title Wang', and čaotao nere, 'the rank of Chaotao' · also 'name and fame' (Ming 姓名)
ögbe-že: ög- — to give; past -be, '-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [與了 也者︀]
edöġe: edöġe — now (adverb) [今] · also 'now' with Ming 如今
öġer-ün: öġer — own, self; genitive -ün after r (pronoun + case) [自己(的)]
jeri: -jer — instrumental, 'with' (suffix, case; the bracketed (i)s of köġud(i)-jer(i)-jen are Shiratori's; compare köġüd(i)-jer-en, 'with one's own sons') [兒子每 自的行]
jen: -(i)jen — reflexive-possessive, one's own (front-vowel form; the token left after köġüd(i)-; here 'her own') [子每(自的)行] · also after ger-tür(i)- (dative-locative), 'one's own home' · also after ökin(i)-, 'one's own daughter' · also after kekül(i)- ('one's own tuft'), šibülgel(i)- ('one's own braid') and nidün-dür(i)- ('in one's own eye'), and after the accusative in žeġüdün-(n)i-jen (token ni-jen) · also after bergen(i)- ('one's own sister-in-law') and deġü-ner(i)- ('one's own younger brothers'), where the (i) is Shiratori's accusative; also after köġün(i)- ('one's own son') and ökid(i)- ('one's own daughters') · also -(i)jen after esüg(i)- ('one's own ripe mare's milk') and after -dür(i)- ('to one's own', ulus irgen -dür(i)-jen) · also after emeġel(i)- ('one's own saddle') · also after hüker(i)- ('one's own ox'), güžüġün-dür(i)-, ebčeġün-dür(i)- ('at one's own neck, chest') and üge-dür(i)- ('in one's own word') · also after ösül(i)- ('one's own enmity'), ebür(i)- ('one's own bosom'), čeriġüd(i)- ('one's own troops') and deġel(i)- ('one's own robe') · also after üges-tür(i)- ('in one's own words'), nököd(i)- ('one's own companions'), helige-ber(i)- ('prone, lying', analysis uncertain) and plain tür(i)- ('in one's own') · also after čerig(i)- ('one's own troops') and eje-dür(i)- ('in one's own counsel', eje uncertain), the token left being jen · also after geġüd(i)- ('one's own mares', stem uncertain) and öġer(i)- ('one's own self', Ming 自己 自), the token left being jen
bolžu: bol- — to become; converb -žu, 'becoming' (verb, converb) [做着]
ejetüldüžü: ejetüldü- — to consult together; converb -žü (verb, converb; analysis uncertain, Ming 商量) [商量着]
ülü-ü: ülü — not; followed by -ü, a particle of question (uncertain; the Ming puts its 麽 on the next word) (negative particle + particle) [不]
aqu: a- — to dwell, stay; participle -qu, 'the one who stays' (verb, participle) [住] · also 'there is' (Ming 有; a- as 'be', not 'dwell')
öṅgür: Öṅgür — Önggür, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
γurban: γurban — three [三] · also 'three' of horses (Ming 三疋)
tarqud: Tarqud — the Tarqud, a people [種名]
köġü: köġü — son (a short form of köġün) (noun) [兒]
bišiγ̇ud: Bišiγ̇ud — the Bishi'ud, a people [種名]
bajaγ̇udi: Bajaγ̇ud — the Baja'ud, a people (proper name); the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the instrumental -jar [種名每 自的行]
jar: -jar — instrumental: with, by means of (case suffix; the token left after moṅgirsun(i)-; the Ming 敎 marks the means) [薤敎] · also in jabuγad(i)-jar, 'on foot' (Ming 步行着, the whole word; the token left after jabuγad(i)-, analysis uncertain) · also after arasun(i)- ('with the hide', Ming 皮子敎), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Turqaγ̇ud(i)- (a mountain name; Ming 依着), 'along, by way of the Turqaqud' · also in γar(i)-jar, 'with the hand' (instrumental; Ming 手用, the whole word; the token left after γar(i)-) · also after uruγ(i)- ('with one's whole clan'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also γažar(i)-jar, 'by way of the land, through' (Ming 地面 裏 / 地行) · also after turγaγ̇ud(i)-, 'leading the guards' (Ming 護衞(每)領着, 領着 'leading', uncertain) · also after šiltaγ̇an(i)-, 'for that reason, because of' (Ming 因; šiltaγ̇an(i)-jar, the token left being jar)
ta: ta — you, plural polite (second-person plural pronoun; stem tan- before case endings) [(您)]
na-dur: bi — I (first-person singular; oblique stem na-); -dur dative-locative: to, at (back-vowel form) [我行]
nigen: nigen — one, a [一] · also 'together, as one' (Ming 一同) · also 'one, a' with Ming 一箇, before the thing counted
küreġen: küreġen — ring of tents, circle camp (a spelling beside kürijen; Ming 圈子 'circle') [圈子]
ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
köiten: Köiten — Köiten, a place name (Ming 地名) [地名] · also köiten — cold (adjective), beside noitan 'wet' and köšildüžü 'being cold together'; the Ming 地名 'place name' looks a slip here
jabuba-že: jabu- — to walk, go about; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 行了 也者︀) [行了 也者︀]
ambar: ambar — what, something (Ming 甚麽; sense uncertain; the word is not known elsewhere, and 'what' is the Ming's reading) [甚麽] · also 'how' (Ming 怎生)
sojurγal: sojurγal — favour, grace, bounty (noun; from sojurγa- 'to show favour') [恩賜]
abqu: ab- — to take; participle -qu, 'that will take' (verb, participle) [要]
aqa: aqa — elder brother (noun) [兄] · also Ming 長 'eldest', in aqa Žüči, 'the eldest, Jüchi' (the noun used as an adjective)
min-u: min-u — my, of me (bi, genitive stem min-, + -u, set after its noun) [我的]
qari: qari — foreign, of another country (adjective; Ming 邦 'state') [邦]
bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
sojurγaγ̇asu: sojurγa- — to show favour, bestow a grace (Ming 恩賜); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if, when (he) favours' (Ming 呵) (verb, conditional) [恩賜呵]
že: že — particle, 'indeed, so' (the Ming 也者 'so be it') [(也者︀)] · also 'so, very well' (Ming 那般), a particle that opens a sentence · also the word of assent, 'yes' (Ming 應許聲 'a sound of agreement'), answering a proposal · also after a name, the shouted call (Temüžin že, Ming 也者; the force is uncertain) · also a closing 'indeed' (Ming 也者), as in ta ečiges köġüd-ün tusa ažuγui že
čiγ̇ulγažu: čiγ̇ul- — to gather, assemble (stem inferred from the Ming 聚); causative -γa-; converb -žu, 'making gather' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [敎聚着]
mede: mede- — to know (bare stem, imperative: 'know!') (verb, imperative) [知者︀]
miṅγan: miṅγan — thousand (numeral; as a unit, a thousand-man body) [千]
bolurun: bol- — to become (verb); -urun, converb of time, 'when becoming' (verb, converb; Ming 做的) [做的]
boroγ̇ul: Boroγ̇ul — Boroqul, a boy's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇] · also before the thing counted: qojar sumu, 'two arrows' (Ming 兩隻 'two (arrows)')
baraγ̇un: baraγ̇un — right (hand or side; adjective; Ming 右) [右]
žeġün: žeġün — left (hand or side; Ming 左) (adjective) [左] · also a man's name, Jegün (personal name; Ming 人名)
baγ̇určin: baγ̇určin — cook (noun; Ming 厨子) [厨子]
ülü: ülü — not (negates present or converb forms) [不] · also before participles (ülü boluqui, ülü ögteküi), 'not' · also before a bare stem (ülü buča 'does not conceal') and a converb (ülü jaγaran 'not hurrying')
qojar-i: qojar — two; accusative -i, 'the two' as object (numeral + case; Ming 兩箇行) [兩箇行]
qoγ̇olai: qoγ̇olai — throat (noun; Ming 喉嚨); with težiġe- 'rear' it is read as the idiom of feeding [喉嚨]
morilažu: morin — horse; verb-forming -la-, converb -žu, 'mounting' (noun-derived verb, converb) [上馬着]
jabužu: jabu- — to go, travel; converb -žu, 'going' (verb, converb) [行着]
ideġe: ideġe — food, something to eat (Ming 喫食) (noun) [喫食]
küġün-e: küġün — person, man (not köġün 'son'); dative -e, 'to a man, to someone' (noun + case; Ming 人行) [人行]
saγ̇uri: saγ̇uri — seat, place of sitting, one's rank in sitting (noun; Ming 坐次, 坐位) [坐次]
saγ̇utuγai: saγu- — to sit; optative -tuγai, 'let them sit' (the Ming 敎 'cause' is not shown in the form) (verb, optative) [敎坐者︀]
saγ̇urin: saγ̇urin — a place for sitting, a post, a station (from saγ̇u- 'sit'; read from the Ming 坐位) (noun) [坐位]
ögbe: ög- — to give; past -be, 'gave' (verb, past tense) [與了]
